title: Open-minded with a bright personality and small ego.
summary: Daily rhythm, roots, philosophy, interests, pattern-spotting and sense of humour.

blocks.title: I wake up, stretch, meditate, have a coffee, then go on making software simpler for humans.
My roots
paragraphs: Originally from Poland, spent most of my adult life in London.

blocks.title: My philosophy
paragraphs: Always improving – things, products, processes, people, or myself. I try to leave everything a little better than I found it.

blocks.title: My interests
paragraphs: Bio-hacking, physical and cognitive health, psychology, philosophy, traveling, cooking, and some weird ones too!

blocks.title: My sixth-sense
paragraphs: Seeing things that others don't. Spotting patterns and connections between seemingly disparate things. I love finding order in chaos and achieving simplicity out of complexity.

blocks.title: My seventh-sense
paragraphs: Is sense of humour ;) I'm positive, cheerful and love a good laugh, good pun, and meme, but I'm also tactful and respectful.
